description: Secondary Substation Feeding Areas is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. A shapefile containing the postcode areas supplied by secondary substations. The dataset is generalised using our GIS customer connectivity model. Each Secondary Substation's connected LV Network is traced out to its electrical extents, including all connected customers. Coverage: Greater London Authority. The portal files it under the publisher Greater London Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
